response.overview: A documentary that follows the members of the comparsas of the Concepción de la Sierra Carnival, in Misiones, during the year of work leading up to the three days of celebration. Amid financial constraints, family tensions and the voices opposed to the festivities, each participant devotes their time and resources to the competition for the symbolic trophy for best comparsa, in a celebration that, for just 72 hours, completely transforms the town.
response.title: Tres noches al año
